summary: community.routeros api_modify needs librouteros 4.0.0+ for container entries because older versions can't set cmd properties.
questions: Which librouteros version do I need to manage RouterOS containers?

answer_card.title: librouteros 4.0.0 needed for containers
answer_card.answer_md: To create or modify entries in the RouterOS `container` path with `api_modify`, use **librouteros 4.0.0 or newer**; older versions can't set properties named `cmd`.
